stefan-nemanja.title: File:Hilandar 28.jpg
stefan-nemanja.description: "Hilandar - The Unexpected Journey" is set of a 30 photos, which represents an important place of pilgrimage, the Mount Athos in Greece, and a religious building such as Hilandar Monastery on Mount Athos, in a different way than so far usual. The author of photographies, in a manner of film location manager,  researched this area and founded places and angles which could be a perfect scenery for a future film achievement in the field of epic fantasy. His camera captured moments of eternity and managed to conjure up the atmosphere of this unusual space;  to illuminate " forgotten gold " about which  Tolkien says in his books "Hobbit".
